articles.title_en: Winners and losers of generative AI: Early Evidence of Shifts in Freelancer Demand
articles.title_cn: 生成式人工智能的赢家与输家：自由职业者需求变化的早期证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine how ChatGPT has changed the demand for freelancers in jobs where generative AI tools can act as substitutes or complements to human labor. Using BERTopic we partition job postings from a leading online freelancing platform into 116 fine-grained skill clusters and with GPT-4o we classify them as substitutable, complementary or unaffected by LLMs. Our analysis reveals that labor demand increased after the launch of ChatGPT, but only in skill clusters that were complementary to or unaffected by the AI tool. In contrast, demand for substitutable skills, such as writing and translation, decreased by 20–50% relative to the counterfactual trend, with the sharpest decline observed for short-term (1-3 week) jobs. Within complementary skill clusters, the results are mixed: demand for machine learning programming grew by 24%, and demand for AI-powered chatbot development nearly tripled, while demand for novice workers declined in general. This result suggests a shift toward more specialized expertise for freelancers rather than uniform growth across all complementary areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了ChatGPT如何改变了在生成式人工智能工具可以作为人类劳动的替代品或互补品的职业中对自由职业者的需求。利用BERTopic，我们将来自一家领先的在线自由职业平台的职位发布划分为116个细粒度技能集群，并使用GPT-4o将它们分类为可替代、互补或不受大语言模型影响。我们的分析显示，ChatGPT发布后劳动力需求有所增加，但仅限于与AI工具互补或不受其影响的技能集群。相比之下，对于可替代技能（如写作和翻译）的需求相对于反事实趋势下降了20-50%，其中短期（1-3周）工作的下降最为显著。在互补技能集群内部，结果不一：机器学习编程的需求增长了24%，AI驱动的聊天机器人开发需求几乎翻了三倍，而新手工人的需求普遍下降。这一结果表明，自由职业者的需求正转向更专业的专长，而非在所有互补领域均匀增长。

articles.title_en: Doing good in the digital world
articles.title_cn: 在数字世界中行善
articles.abstract_en: Though digital interactions between people have become more commonplace and sophisticated, behavior in digital settings remains underresearched. A distinctive feature of the digital world is the ability to calibrate or withhold one’s identifier: a person can be identified by a string of letters, an avatar, their real name, or even nothing at all. Moreover, that digital identifiers allow a person to mask their physical identity also makes it difficult to attribute digital actions to a physical person, even when the actions are observed. I embed these two features in a laboratory experiment where subjects play a finitely repeated, linear public goods game. Treated subjects are identified in one of three ways—by their photograph, by a random number, or by a self-designed cartoon avatar—and their individual choices are revealed and either attributed to, or decoupled from, their identifier. In line with the previous literature, identifying subjects and increasing the precision of attribution increases contributions relative to a baseline condition without identifiers or revealed individual choices. Remarkably, the treatment effect is robust to less precise identifiers and attribution: contributions increase significantly even when subjects are identified by numbers and their individual contributions are revealed, but decoupled from, those numbers.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管人与人之间的数字互动已变得更加普遍和复杂，数字环境中的行为研究仍然不足。数字世界的一个显著特征是能够校准或隐藏个人标识符：一个人可以通过一串字母、一个头像、真实姓名，甚至完全不显示任何信息来被识别。此外，数字标识符允许个人掩盖其物理身份，这也使得将数字行为归因于具体个人变得困难，即使这些行为被观察到。我将这两个特征嵌入到一个实验室实验中，受试者参与一个有限重复的线性公共品博弈。受试者通过三种方式之一被识别——通过照片、随机数字或自行设计的卡通头像——并且他们的个人选择被揭示，并与他们的标识符相关联或脱钩。与先前文献一致，识别受试者并提高归因精度相对于无标识符或未揭示个人选择的基线条件增加了贡献。值得注意的是，处理效应对于较不精确的标识符和归因是稳健的：即使受试者通过数字被识别且其个人贡献被揭示但与这些数字脱钩，贡献也显著增加。

articles.title_en: Brigandage and the political legacy of monarchical legitimacy in Southern Italy
articles.title_cn: 南意大利的匪患与君主制合法性的政治遗产
articles.abstract_en: Political legitimacy plays a pivotal role in securing the effectiveness and longevity of a governing system, yet it can be eroded by the way rulers handle popular uprisings. This paper studies whether a historical shock in the legitimacy of monarchic rule can have long-term, intergenerational consequences on political attitudes. The unification of Italy ignited a violent reaction against the new ruler in its southern provinces known as the “Great Brigandage”. We use fixed effects regressions with a wide set of controls and an instrumental variable approach based on military suitability of the terrain in order to show that, ceteris paribus, municipalities exposed to brigandage in the 1861–1870 period had lower turnout in the 1946 Institutional Referendum and were significantly less likely to vote for the survival of the monarchy. Heterogeneity analysis leveraging a spatial discontinuity in martial law suggests that anti-monarchic sentiment likely stemmed from the collective memory of brigandage repression. We interpret our findings as evidence that latent preferences toward political systems are endogenously shaped by historical events and can be brought to the surface by changes in the institutional environment.
articles.abstract_cn: 政治合法性在确保治理体系的有效性和持久性方面发挥着关键作用，但它可能因统治者处理民众起义的方式而受到侵蚀。本文研究君主统治合法性的历史冲击是否会对政治态度产生长期的、代际相传的后果。意大利统一在其南部省份引发了对新统治者的暴力反抗，即所谓的“大匪患”。我们使用带有广泛控制变量的固定效应回归，以及基于地形军事适宜性的工具变量方法，以表明在其他条件相同的情况下，在1861-1870年期间遭受匪患的市镇在1946年制度公投中的投票率较低，并且显著不太可能投票支持君主制的存续。利用戒严令的空间不连续性进行的异质性分析表明，反君主情绪可能源于对匪患镇压的集体记忆。我们将我们的发现解释为，对政治体系的潜在偏好是由历史事件内生塑造的，并且可以通过制度环境的变化而浮出水面。

articles.title_en: In or out? Crowding effects in public goods with private gifts: Evidence from crowdfunding
articles.title_cn: 进还是出？公共品与私人赠礼中的拥挤效应：来自众筹的证据
articles.abstract_en: How do cumulative contributions influence subsequent giving to public goods that offer private gifts? While prior research has examined contribution dynamics in fundraising, the role of excludability — the property of preventing noncontributors from accessing the good — remains largely unexplored. We use comprehensive data from a reward-based crowdfunding platform to show that the excludability of a project significantly shapes its contribution pattern. We introduce two novel measures of excludability: one based on a good’s inherent characteristics and another derived from the geographic distribution of backer-project distances. Our analysis reveals that more excludable goods (such as local projects and tangible products) exhibit stronger crowding-in effects, whereas less excludable ones (such as global projects and journalism) experience crowding-out effects. Although crowdfunding platforms systematically highlight cumulative contributions, our findings suggest that fundraisers should emphasize this information, particularly for excludable goods, but not for the least excludable ones.
articles.abstract_cn: 累计贡献如何影响后续对提供私人赠礼的公共品的捐赠？虽然先前的研究已经考察了筹款中的贡献动态，但排他性——即阻止非贡献者获取该物品的属性——的作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。我们利用来自一个奖励型众筹平台的全面数据，表明项目的排他性显著塑造了其贡献模式。我们引入了两种新的排他性度量：一种基于物品的内在特征，另一种来源于支持者-项目距离的地理分布。我们的分析揭示，更具排他性的物品（如本地项目和实物产品）表现出更强的挤入效应，而排他性较弱的物品（如全球项目和新闻业）则经历挤出效应。尽管众筹平台系统性地突出累计贡献，我们的发现表明，筹款者应强调这一信息，特别是对于排他性物品，但对于排他性最弱的物品则不应如此。

articles.title_en: Coalitions for sustainable consumption: Understanding the emergence of shared ownership in an Agent-Based Model
articles.title_cn: 可持续消费的联盟：理解基于主体的模型中共享所有权的出现
articles.abstract_en: Sharing ownership of goods, like cars or drills, used by a single owner for a small fraction of their life-time, can mitigate environmental impacts. But are consumers ready to give up individual property rights on underutilised goods? We propose a simple model to study conditions favouring consumers purchasing a private good in coalition rather than individually. By exploring the model parameter space, encompassing characteristics and preferences of heterogeneous consumers, those of the private good and of a public service that offers the same service of the good, we identify the emergence of shared ownership. It predominantly occurs under niche conditions: among lower-income consumers with above-average demand, especially when the shared good is relatively small and purchasable in small coalitions — which have lower coordination challenges. Shared ownership reduces the net number of goods in an economy and production-related environmental impact, even in the absence of consumers’ sustainability concerns. Policies reducing the relative price of the shared purchase accelerate the transition to a more sustainable shared consumption. However, we do not find any impact of shared ownership in reducing inequality in accessing goods.
articles.abstract_cn: 共享商品的所有权，如汽车或钻头，这些商品在单个所有者手中仅使用其寿命的一小部分，可以减轻环境影响。但消费者是否准备好放弃对未充分利用商品的个人财产权？我们提出了一个简单模型来研究消费者以联盟而非个人形式购买私人商品的条件。通过探索模型参数空间，涵盖异质性消费者的特征和偏好、私人商品以及提供相同服务的公共服务的特征，我们识别出共享所有权的出现。它主要在利基条件下发生：在需求高于平均水平的低收入消费者中，尤其是当共享商品相对较小且可以小规模联盟购买时——这些联盟的协调挑战较低。共享所有权减少了经济中商品的总数和与生产相关的环境影响，即使消费者没有可持续性关切。降低共享购买相对价格的政策加速了向更可持续的共享消费的过渡。然而，我们没有发现共享所有权在减少获取商品的不平等方面有任何影响。

articles.title_en: Different norms of sexual activity and consent seeking among college students: Social identity and statistical discrimination
articles.title_cn: 大学生性行为和同意寻求的不同规范：社会认同和统计歧视
articles.abstract_en: Preventing sexual assault on university campuses is rooted in promoting the adoption and practice of seeking consent. Using identity theory and a factorial vignette survey experiment, we test for the presence of implicit differences in appropriateness ratings based on context, gender, race and sexual orientation and, in aggregate, differences in social norms that govern college students’ sexual interactions. We provide a simple theoretical framework of statistical discrimination where the social norms for identical actions are predicted to differ because the appropriateness of actions is imperfectly observed and evaluators hold beliefs about underlying propensities of appropriate action that are rooted in identity. Our results show that context significantly alters perceptions of appropriate behavior and that heterosexual male actions are viewed as systematically less socially appropriate. We validate our findings with a post-study questionnaire which reveals that beliefs regarding appropriateness ratings are largely driven by the perceived rates of sexual assault among the represented population by the vignette narrator. The paper advances the study of norms rooted in identity and presents an identity-based theoretical framework that provides intuition for how such a differences may arise.
articles.abstract_cn: 防止大学校园性侵犯的根源在于促进征求同意的采用和实践。利用身份理论和阶乘小插曲调查实验，我们测试了基于背景、性别、种族和性取向的适当性评级是否存在隐性差异，以及总体上管理大学生性互动的社会规范的差异。我们提供了一个简单的统计歧视理论框架，其中相同行为的社会规范预计会有所不同，因为行为的适当性未被完全观察到，并且评估者对植根于身份的适当行为的潜在倾向持有信念。我们的研究结果表明，环境显着改变了对适当行为的看法，异性恋男性的行为被认为系统性地不太适合社会。我们通过研究后调查问卷验证了我们的发现，该调查显示，关于适当性评级的信念很大程度上是由小插曲叙述者所代表的人群中性侵犯的感知率驱动的。本文推进了对植根于身份的规范的研究，并提出了一个基于身份的理论框架，为这种差异如何产生提供了直觉。

articles.title_en: Can gender and race dynamics in performance appraisals be disrupted? The case of social influence
articles.title_cn: 绩效评估中的性别与种族动态能否被打破？社会影响的案例
articles.abstract_en: We document gender and race dynamics in performance evaluations in a multi-national company, examining the impacts of a feature of the performance appraisal process: managers’ knowledge of employees’ self-evaluations. Generally, (White) women were rated higher than men and people of color were rated lower than White employees. Women of color gave themselves the lowest self-ratings. When self-evaluations were unavailable due to a quasi-exogenous shock, manager and self-ratings were less correlated. However, gender and race gaps remained unchanged as managers anchored on previous years’ ratings. Based on suggestive evidence, women of color without an employment history benefitted from their self-ratings not being shared.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了一家跨国公司绩效评估中的性别与种族动态，考察了绩效评估过程的一个特征的影响：管理者对员工自我评估的了解。总体而言，（白人）女性的评分高于男性，有色人种员工的评分低于白人员工。有色人种女性给自己的自我评分最低。当由于准外生冲击而无法获得自我评估时，管理者评分与自我评分的相关性降低。然而，性别和种族差距保持不变，因为管理者锚定于前几年的评分。基于提示性证据，没有工作历史的有色人种女性因自我评估未被分享而受益。

articles.title_en: Moral preferences over health-wealth trade-offs
articles.title_cn: 健康与财富权衡中的道德偏好
articles.abstract_en: Using a choice experiment we analyze moral preferences over fatalities and jobs losses due to the pandemic in Italy, the UK and the US. We find that the participants’ utility function is mostly driven by health outcomes, and that respondents’ stable traits (such as political orientation or risk aversion) influence attitudes more than their personal experiences with the consequences of the pandemic. A structural estimation also displays, surprisingly, aversion to diversification among these two bads. Moreover, policy responses look misaligned with estimated preferences. Italy adopted more stringent containment measures, while Italian respondents display a relatively weaker pro-health attitude.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过一项选择实验，我们分析了意大利、英国和美国因疫情导致的死亡与失业问题上的道德偏好。我们发现参与者的效用函数主要由健康结果驱动，并且受访者的稳定特质（如政治倾向或风险厌恶）比他们个人经历疫情后果的经验更能影响态度。一项结构估计还出人意料地显示出对这些两种不良结果的多样化厌恶。此外，政策回应似乎与估计的偏好不一致。意大利采取了更严格的遏制措施，而意大利受访者则表现出相对较弱的亲健康态度。

articles.title_en: How scary is the risk of automation? Evidence from a large-scale survey experiment
articles.title_cn: 自动化风险有多可怕？来自大规模调查实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Technological advancements have always shaped labor markets; however, emerging AI innovations like ChatGPT are now putting occupations previously considered "safe" from technological substitution at significant risk of automation. This study examines individuals' willingness to pay to reduce automation risk, using a discrete-choice experiment conducted with nearly 6000 participants. Results reveal that respondents accept a salary reduction of almost 20 % of the Swiss median annual gross wage to reduce their automation risk by 10 percentage points or, conversely, demand a 20 % risk premium to accept an equivalent increase in automation risk. Interestingly, the study finds that WTP for risk reduction increases with higher baseline automation risk levels, contrary to patterns observed in other contexts. While preferences are generally homogeneous, differences exist between demographic groups. Men, younger and risk-tolerant individuals, and those with higher education show lower willingness to pay for reduced automation risk. By having respondents express preferences for hypothetical children, the study also explores potential gender biases, finding no significant differences in willingness to pay for reduced automation risk, educational degrees, hierarchical position, or wage based on the child's gender.
articles.abstract_cn: 技术进步一直塑造着劳动力市场；然而，像ChatGPT这样的新兴人工智能创新现在正使那些先前被认为“安全”于技术替代的职业面临显著的自动化风险。本研究通过一项涉及近6000名参与者的离散选择实验，考察了个人为降低自动化风险而愿意支付的金额。结果显示，受访者接受减少相当于瑞士年工资中位数近20%的薪资，以将其自动化风险降低10个百分点；或者相反，要求20%的风险溢价以接受同等程度的自动化风险增加。有趣的是，研究发现，降低风险的支付意愿随着基线自动化风险水平的升高而增加，这与在其他情境中观察到的模式相反。尽管偏好总体上是同质的，但不同人口群体之间存在差异。男性、较年轻且风险容忍度高的个体，以及受教育程度较高者，对降低自动化风险的支付意愿较低。通过让受访者表达对假设子女的偏好，研究还探讨了潜在的性别偏见，发现基于子女性别，在降低自动化风险的支付意愿、教育程度、职位层级或工资方面没有显著差异。

articles.title_en: Trade and the rise of ancient Greek city-states
articles.title_cn: 贸易与古希腊城邦的兴起
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, I examine the role of comparative advantage in the rise of city-states. After compiling a new dataset on ancient Greece and the natural environment, I provide evidence that the spatial covariance of natural vegetation endowments amongst potential trading partners is important for explaining the development of silver coin money, battles, and city-state formation. I also provide statistical evidence against “key factors” previously emphasized. These findings are consistent with a general model of comparative advantage that I develop, which clarifies how the spatial covariance of factor endowments affects multiple development outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我考察了比较优势在城邦兴起中的作用。在编制了一个关于古希腊和自然环境的新数据集后，我提供的证据表明，潜在贸易伙伴之间自然植被禀赋的空间协方差对于解释银币货币的发展、战争和城邦形成具有重要意义。我还提供了针对先前强调的“关键因素”的统计证据。这些发现与我提出的一个一般比较优势模型相一致，该模型阐明了要素禀赋的空间协方差如何影响多种发展结果。

articles.title_en: Firm consolidation and labor market outcomes
articles.title_cn: 企业合并与劳动力市场结果
articles.abstract_en: Using rich administrative data from the Netherlands, we study the consequences of firm consolidation for workers. For workers at acquired firms, takeovers are associated with a 8.5% drop in employment at the consolidated firm and a 2.6% drop in total labor income. These effects persist even four years after the takeover and are consistent with job losses driven by involuntary separations. Few takeovers change labor market concentration meaningfully. Instead, restructuring at consolidating firms is likely to be an important mechanism behind our findings. Specifically, workers with skills that are already present at acquirers are less likely to be retained and overtime hours and part-time work are reduced.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用荷兰丰富的行政数据，我们研究了企业合并对工人的影响。对于被收购企业的工人而言，收购与合并后企业就业率下降8.5%和总劳动收入下降2.6%相关。这些效应在收购后四年依然持续，并且与由非自愿离职导致的失业情况一致。很少有收购会显著改变劳动力市场集中度。相反，合并企业的重组可能是我们发现背后的重要机制。具体来说，技能在收购方中已经存在的工人更不可能被保留，加班时间和兼职工作减少。

articles.title_en: Making up for harming others — An experiment on voluntary compensation behavior
articles.title_cn: 弥补对他人的伤害——关于自愿补偿行为的实验
articles.abstract_en: We investigate in a controlled laboratory setting to what extent buyers are willing to offset negative consumption externalities. In one treatment dimension, we vary whether the externality associated with a purchase is irreversible or can be reduced ex post by a voluntary payment. In a second treatment dimension, we induce diffusion of harm among harmed subjects and diffusion of responsibility among buyers by separately varying the matching of buyers and harmed subjects. We find that subjects are, on average, willing to compensate for their negative externalities and that this willingness is sensitive to the surplus from buying. Yet, experimental buyers are highly heterogeneous, with some never compensating. While the introduction of voluntary compensation significantly reduces externalities, the net externality still remains high across all treatments. Diffusion of responsibility tends to reduce the size of compensation and to increase overall net externalities in the main experiment. An additional control treatment reveals that under diffusion of responsibility among buyers, patterns of conditional cooperation seem to drive compensation in the present setting: the amount paid for compensation increases with higher beliefs about the compensation by other buyers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在受控实验室环境中调查了买家在多大程度上愿意抵消负面消费外部性。在一个处理维度上，我们变化购买相关的外部性是不可逆的还是可以通过自愿支付事后减少。在第二个处理维度上，我们通过分别变化买家与受害者的匹配方式，诱导了受害者之间的伤害扩散和买家之间的责任扩散。我们发现，平均而言，受试者愿意为其负面外部性进行补偿，并且这种意愿对购买盈余敏感。然而，实验买家高度异质，有些人从不补偿。虽然引入自愿补偿显著减少了外部性，但在所有处理中，净外部性仍然很高。责任扩散倾向于减少补偿规模，并在主要实验中增加总体净外部性。一个额外的对照处理揭示，在买家之间的责任扩散下，条件合作模式似乎在当前环境中驱动补偿：支付的补偿金额随着对其他买家补偿的更高信念而增加。

articles.title_en: Gender Gaps in the Federal Reserve System
articles.title_cn: 联邦储备系统中的性别差距
articles.abstract_en: To better understand the stalled progress of women in economics, we construct new data on women’s representation and research output in one of the largest policy institutions—the Federal Reserve System. We document a slight increase in women’s representation over the past 20 years, in line with academic trends. We also document a significant gender gap in research output, including for years in which economists have greater domestic responsibilities, but nearly absent gender gaps in policy output and career progression. This work complements existing research on women in academia, allowing a more comprehensive examination of progress in the economics profession.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了更好地理解女性在经济学领域进展停滞的现象，我们构建了关于女性在最大政策机构之一——联邦储备系统中的代表性和研究产出的新数据。我们记录了在过去20年中女性代表性的轻微增长，这与学术趋势一致。我们还记录了研究产出中显著的性别差距，包括在经济学家承担更多家庭责任的年份，但在政策产出和职业晋升方面几乎不存在性别差距。这项工作补充了现有关于学术界女性的研究，使得对经济学职业进展的考察更为全面。

articles.title_en: Environmental policies with green network effect and price discrimination
articles.title_cn: 具有绿色网络效应和价格歧视的环境政策
articles.abstract_en: We consider a duopolistic market in which a green firm competes with a brown rival, and both firms offer vertically differentiated products. Consumers are heterogeneous both in their willingness to pay for hedonic quality and in their environmental concern. The latter is positively related to the green firm’s market share, giving rise to a green network effect. We characterize how price and quality schedules are set and how consumers sort between the two firms at the market equilibrium. When considering pollution from both consumption and production, we compute total welfare and evaluate the impact of different environmental policies. Our analysis demonstrates that efficiency can be achieved through a uniform emission tax, which restores the optimal differential between firms’ intrinsic qualities. Notably, we find that a discriminatory subsidy, which decreases with the willingness to pay for intrinsic quality, re-establishes the optimal sorting of consumers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个双寡头市场，其中一家绿色企业与一家棕色竞争对手竞争，两家企业均提供垂直差异化产品。消费者在支付意愿（针对享乐质量）和环境关注度方面存在异质性。后者与绿色企业的市场份额正相关，从而产生绿色网络效应。我们刻画了市场价格和质量计划的设定方式，以及市场均衡中消费者如何在两家企业之间进行选择。在考虑消费和生产两方面污染时，我们计算总福利并评估不同环境政策的影响。我们的分析表明，通过统一的排放税可以实现效率，该税种恢复了企业内在质量之间的最优差异。值得注意的是，我们发现，一种随内在质量支付意愿递减的歧视性补贴，能够重新建立消费者的最优选择。

articles.title_en: Jumping the queue: An experimental study on cultural differences in bribing attitudes among Greeks and Germans
articles.title_cn: 插队：希腊人和德国人行贿态度文化差异的实验研究
articles.abstract_en: We examine how queuing processes in public service provision influence individuals' propensity to engage in bribery. We introduce the queue-jumping game, distinguishing between queue-jumping bribes (to advance one's position) and counter-bribes (to maintain one's position when threatened by queue-jumping). Participants from Greece and Germany, countries with different levels of perceived corruption, played the game in monocultural and intercultural groups. Our findings reveal that in monocultural settings, Greek participants initially exhibited higher bribery rates than German participants, driven primarily by more frequent queue-jumping. However, these cultural differences diminished over repeated interactions, suggesting strategic adaptation. Crucially, analysis indicates that bribing to queue-jump incurs a substantially higher moral cost than counter-bribing for both nationalities. Furthermore, Greek participants perceived counter-bribing as significantly more socially inappropriate than their German counterparts, helping explain the higher initial rates of queue-jumping among Greek participants. In intercultural groups, we found only limited evidence of minority participants adjusting behavior towards majority norms, although minorities consistently earned less regardless of nationality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究公共服务提供中的排队过程如何影响个人的贿赂倾向。我们介绍插队游戏，区分插队贿赂（以提升自己的地位）和反贿赂（在受到插队威胁时维持自己的地位）。来自希腊和德国这两个腐败程度不同的国家的参与者在单一文化和跨文化群体中玩游戏。我们的研究结果表明，在单一文化环境中，希腊参与者最初表现出比德国参与者更高的贿赂率，这主要是由于更频繁的插队。然而，这些文化差异随着反复的互动而消失，这表明战略适应。至关重要的是，分析表明，对于两国来说，行贿插队所带来的道德成本远高于反行贿。此外，希腊参与者认为反贿赂明显比德国参与者更不适合社会，这有助于解释希腊参与者最初插队的比例较高。在跨文化群体中，我们只发现少数群体参与者根据多数群体规范调整行为的证据有限，尽管无论国籍如何，少数群体的收入始终较低。

articles.title_en: Implementing efficiency with equality
articles.title_cn: 实现效率与公平并重
articles.abstract_en: We consider the implementation of efficiency with minimum inequality in a large population model of negative externalities. Formally, the model is one of tragedy of the commons with the aggregate strategy at the efficient state being lower than at the Nash equilibrium. A planner can restore efficiency by imposing an externality equivalent tax and then redistributing the tax revenue as transfers to lower inequality. We characterize the payment scheme that minimizes inequality, as measured by the Gini coefficient, at the efficient state subject to incentive compatibility and budget balance. We then construct a mechanism that implements efficiency with minimum inequality in dominant strategies. We also show that minimizing inequality at the efficient state maximizes the minimum payoff at efficiency. However, it is not equivalent to implementing the Rawlsian social choice function.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在负外部性的大规模人口模型中，以最小不平等实现效率的实施问题。形式上，该模型是公地悲剧模型，其中有效状态下的总体策略低于纳什均衡状态下的总体策略。规划者可以通过征收外部性等价税来恢复效率，然后将税收收入作为转移支付进行再分配，以降低不平等。我们刻画了在激励相容和预算平衡约束下，以基尼系数衡量的有效状态下最小化不平等的支付方案。随后，我们构建了一个在占优策略下以最小不平等实现效率的机制。我们还表明，在有效状态下最小化不平等会最大化效率状态下的最低收益。然而，这并不等同于实施罗尔斯主义社会选择函数。

articles.title_en: Covid19 and consumer animus towards Chinese products: Evidence from Amazon data
articles.title_cn: 新冠疫情与消费者对中国产品的敌意：来自亚马逊数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: We tracked all facemasks sold on Amazon from Sep. 2019 to Sep. 2020 and analyzed seller-generated product information as well as user-generated reviews. Using a fully dynamic event study we found the average user rating of a facemask dropped significantly following the first consumer review or question and answer stating it was made in China, but not of other countries. This drop expanded in the first three weeks after the identification of Chinese products but then gradually faded out within twelve weeks. The U-shape post identification is explained by a review’s direct (its own rating) and indirect (other consumers’ ratings) impact on average rating and was driven by Chinese products with high reputation. By analyzing consumer reviews, we provided strong evidence that the drop in average rating was driven by consumer animus to China and Chinese products rather than product quality or shipping.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们追踪了从2019年九月至2020年九月在亚马逊上销售的所有口罩，并分析了卖家生成的产品信息以及用户生成的评论。通过使用完全动态事件研究，我们发现，在首次消费者评论或问答指出产品为中国制造后，口罩的平均用户评分显著下降，但其他国家制造的产品则没有此现象。这一下降在中国产品被识别后的前三周内扩大，但在十二周内逐渐消退。识别后的U型形态可通过评论对平均评分的直接（其自身评分）和间接（其他消费者评分）影响来解释，并且这一现象由高声誉的中国产品驱动。通过分析消费者评论，我们提供了强有力的证据表明，平均评分的下降是由消费者对中国及中国产品的敌意驱动的，而非产品质量或运输问题。

articles.title_en: Minimum wage and labor self-funded training: evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 最低工资与劳动力自费培训：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of minimum wage increases on labor self-funded training by first constructing a theoretical model that explores the effects under both perfectly and imperfectly competitive market conditions. We then empirically analyze the impact using data on training enterprise registrations and household spending on training. Theoretically, we find an increase in the minimum wage is expected to suppress demand for low-skilled labor, leading affected workers to engage in self-funded training to compete for a limited number of job positions. Empirically, a minimum wage increase significantly boosts the number of newly registered training enterprises and household expenditures on skill training. Mechanism analysis reveals that a higher minimum wage increases labor costs for enterprises, leading them to raise skill requirements during recruitment, thereby encouraging job market participants to pursue self-funded skill training.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过首先构建一个理论模型来考察最低工资上涨对劳动力自费培训的影响，该模型探讨了在完全竞争和不完全竞争市场条件下的效应。然后，我们利用培训企业注册和家庭培训支出的数据进行了实证分析。理论上，我们发现最低工资的上涨预期会抑制对低技能劳动力的需求，导致受影响的工人参与自费培训以竞争有限的工作岗位。实证上，最低工资的上涨显著增加了新注册培训企业的数量和家庭技能培训支出。机制分析显示，较高的最低工资增加了企业的劳动力成本，促使他们在招聘时提高技能要求，从而鼓励就业市场参与者追求自费技能培训。

articles.title_en: Contextualizing child labor reforms: Education policy, legal bans, and female child labor in rural South India
articles.title_cn: 童工改革的情境化：教育政策、法律禁令与印度南部农村女童劳动
articles.abstract_en: The prevailing consensus in the economics literature suggests that child labor laws are generally ineffective. However, this view often overlooks the broader policy context that shapes such reforms. India's 2012 Child Labor Amendment Act emerged after a period of significant reform aimed at improving girls' education, particularly through the 2009 education reforms. This paper sustains that these reforms potentially altered societal perceptions regarding the marginal value of girls' education, while the Child Labor Act highlighted the hazards of child labor in agriculture. Together, these measures may have created a more favorable environment for reducing rural female child labor. Using panel data from Young Lives and a triple difference-in-difference methodology, this study documents a significant reduction in female child labor in rural India. The findings highlight the importance of contextualizing legal reforms and emphasize the need for nuanced assessments to better understand their heterogeneous outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学文献中的主流共识认为，童工法律通常效果不佳。然而，这一观点往往忽视了塑造此类改革的更广泛政策背景。印度的2012年《童工修正法案》是在旨在改善女童教育的重大改革时期之后出台的，特别是通过2009年的教育改革。本文认为，这些改革可能改变了社会对女童教育边际价值的看法，而《童工法》则凸显了农业中童工的危险。这些措施共同可能为减少农村女童劳动创造了更有利的环境。利用Young Lives的面板数据和三重差分法，本研究记录了印度农村女童劳动的显著减少。研究结果强调了将法律改革置于情境中的重要性，并强调需要进行细致评估以更好地理解其异质性结果。

articles.title_en: Speaking differently: How dialect affects E-government adoption
articles.title_cn: 说不同的语言：方言如何影响电子政务的采纳
articles.abstract_en: Leveraging the novel and comprehensive Chinese Business Environment Survey data spanning 2019 to 2023, this paper identifies dialect difference as a significant yet unexplored determinant of electronic government (E-government) services adoption. Our theoretical model posits that dialect-induced language barriers elevate uncertainty about the time (effort) required for successful online administrative interactions, raising the likelihood of procedural failures and thus deterring enterprise engagement with E-government platforms. Exploiting the establishment of the Data Administration Bureau as an exogenous policy shock, we empirically find that, following the intervention, regions predominantly speaking local dialects were 5.1 % less likely to adopt E-government services—equivalent to approximately 5.9 million fewer enterprise users—relative to Mandarin-speaking regions. This effect is significant after controlling for conventional confounding factors such as social networks and cultural clustering, and remains robust across alternative specifications and validation checks. Our findings shed lights on frictions in government digitalization, implying welfare improvements from mitigating dialect-related access constraints.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用覆盖2019年至2023年的新颖且全面的中国商业环境调查数据，本文识别出方言差异是电子政府（电子政务）服务采纳的一个显著但尚未探索的决定因素。我们的理论模型认为，方言引起的语言障碍增加了对成功在线行政互动所需时间（努力）的不确定性，提高了程序失败的可能性，从而阻碍了企业参与电子政务平台。利用数据管理局的设立作为外生政策冲击，我们实证发现，在干预之后，主要使用当地方言的地区采纳电子政务服务的可能性比普通话地区低5.1%，相当于减少了约5.9百万企业用户。在控制了诸如社会网络和文化聚类等常规混淆因素后，这一效应仍然显著，并且在替代规格和验证检查中保持稳健。我们的发现揭示了政府数字化中的摩擦，暗示缓解方言相关的访问限制可以带来福利改善。

articles.title_en: Melting pot: Linguistic diversity and collaboration
articles.title_cn: 熔炉：语言多样性与合作
articles.abstract_en: Collaboration is essential for scientific progress, but forming cooperative relationships in multilingual environments is not well understood. Using a unique dataset of Chinese inventors, this study examines how linguistic diversity influences inventor collaboration. We find that inventors in multilingual settings are more likely to collaborate, a result robust to various endogeneity tests and robustness checks. Multilingual environments facilitate collaboration by providing access to heterogeneous knowledge and lowering search costs for collaborators. We also find that promoting a common language (Putonghua) helps mitigate communication barriers in linguistically diverse societies. Further analysis reveals that multilingual environments encourage inventors to expand their collaborative networks primarily by establishing new partnerships without significantly displacing existing collaborations. Moreover, inventors in multilingual environments are more likely to produce high-impact patents, enhancing their companies’ innovation performance. Overall, these findings highlight the advantage multilingual environments provide in combining diverse knowledge and emphasize the importance of reducing search and communication frictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 合作对于科学进步至关重要，但在多语言环境中形成合作关系尚未得到充分理解。利用中国发明家的独特数据集，本研究考察了语言多样性如何影响发明家合作。我们发现，在多语言环境中的发明家更有可能进行合作，这一结果在各种内生性检验和稳健性检查中均保持稳健。多语言环境通过提供获取异质性知识的途径和降低合作者的搜索成本来促进合作。我们还发现，推广共同语言（普通话）有助于缓解语言多样性社会中的沟通障碍。进一步分析显示，多语言环境鼓励发明家主要通过建立新的伙伴关系来扩展其合作网络，而不会显著取代现有的合作。此外，多语言环境中的发明家更有可能产生高影响力的专利，从而提升其公司的创新绩效。总体而言，这些发现强调了多语言环境在整合多样化知识方面的优势，并强调了减少搜索和沟通摩擦的重要性。

articles.title_en: Hometown favoritism and intra-regional trade barriers under decentralization: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 地方保护主义与分权下的区域内贸易壁垒：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Decentralization management in inter-jurisdictional contexts requires careful consideration. This article highlights the potential for hometown favoritism to undermine decentralization practices. China established its ambitious social credit system in the highway construction sector in 2009, where local rating agencies are responsible for the grading of firms’ social credit ratings. Using a unique dataset spanning 2010–2022, we find that local firms can achieve higher social credit ratings, helping them meet more bidding requirements. Local firms are less likely to be downgraded, and those with stronger local cultural and economic ties receive higher ratings. Hometown favoritism in credit ratings is particularly pronounced for eponymous firms, less important and lower-quality construction projects, and it varies over time, increasing during periods of poor economic performance. Further evidence suggests that local firms win more bids, although changes in local ratings are less predictive of securing new bids. These findings underscore the previously unexplored role of hometown favoritism in creating trade barriers under decentralization.
articles.abstract_cn: 跨辖区背景下的分权管理需要仔细考量。本文强调了地方保护主义可能削弱分权实践的风险。中国于2009年在高速公路建设领域建立了其宏大的社会信用体系，其中地方评级机构负责对企业社会信用评级进行打分。利用覆盖2010-2022年的独特数据集，我们发现本地企业能够获得更高的社会信用评级，从而帮助它们满足更多的投标要求。本地企业被降级的可能性较小，而那些与本地文化和经济联系更紧密的企业则获得更高的评级。信用评级中的地方保护主义在同名企业中尤为显著，对于次要和低质量的建设项目也是如此，并且这种保护主义随时间变化，在经济表现不佳时期有所加剧。进一步的证据表明，本地企业赢得了更多的投标，尽管本地评级的变化对获得新投标的预测能力较弱。这些发现强调了地方保护主义在分权下形成贸易壁垒中此前未被探索的作用。

articles.title_en: The impact of a public voucher for the arts
articles.title_cn: 公共艺术代金券的影响
articles.abstract_en: We provide novel evidence on the impact of a public voucher scheme for cultural consumption. The voucher was introduced in Italy in 2016 for citizens aged 18 years old. We use repeated cross-sections from the annual household survey ‘Aspects of Daily Life’ for the period 2013–2019 and combine Entropy Balancing with Difference-in-Difference estimation to assess the voucher causal effect on cultural consumption. We find a significant impact of the cultural voucher in fostering participation in cinema, non-classic concerts and reading books and online/e-books, with the effect driven by lower SES individuals. Overall, estimated effects suggest a less-than-total crowding out of public resources. The voucher also generated some spillover effects at the household level, and, in the case of cinema, resulted in a sustained higher consumption, even after the financial support terminated.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于公共代金券计划对文化消费影响的新证据。该代金券于2016年在意大利推出，面向年满18岁的公民。我们使用2013-2019年期间年度家庭调查“日常生活方面”的重复横截面数据，结合熵平衡与双重差分估计来评估代金券对文化消费的因果效应。我们发现文化代金券在促进电影、非古典音乐会以及阅读书籍和在线/电子书参与方面具有显著影响，且这一效应由社会经济地位较低的个体驱动。总体而言，估计效应表明公共资源的挤出效应不完全。该代金券还在家庭层面产生了一些溢出效应，并且在电影方面，即使在财政支持终止后，也导致了持续更高的消费水平。

articles.title_en: The demand for complete and incomplete punishment institutions to promote cooperation
articles.title_cn: 完整与不完整惩罚制度的需求及其促进合作的作用
articles.abstract_en: We use an experiment to study the demand for complete and incomplete formal punishment institutions and their ability to promote cooperation. Complete punishment institutions are implemented by the whole group and bind everyone. Incomplete punishment institutions are implemented by a subgroup and bind only the members of this subgroup. We distinguish between strictly incomplete institutions, in which only one subgroup can bind itself while the remaining individuals are unbound, and potentially incomplete institutions, in which two subgroups can bind themselves independently and separately in different institutions, potentially binding everyone. Theoretically, the demand for such formal punishment institutions should depend only on the benefit of cooperation within the group or subgroup bound by the institution. However, we hypothesize and the experimental results confirm that, in the case of incomplete punishment institutions, the benefit of cooperation has a much smaller impact on the demand than in complete punishment institutions. Instead, individuals’ cooperativeness and coordination between the subgroups become important determinants.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究完整与不完整正式惩罚制度的需求及其促进合作的能力。完整惩罚制度由整个群体实施并约束所有人。不完整惩罚制度由子群体实施，仅约束该子群体的成员。我们区分严格不完整制度，即只有一个子群体可以约束自身，而其余个体不受约束；以及潜在不完整制度，即两个子群体可以在不同制度中独立且分别约束自身，可能约束所有人。理论上，对此类正式惩罚制度的需求应仅取决于制度所约束的群体或子群体内合作的收益。然而，我们假设并通过实验结果证实，在不完整惩罚制度的情况下，合作收益对需求的影响远小于完整惩罚制度。相反，个体的合作性以及子群体之间的协调成为重要决定因素。

articles.title_en: House price expectations and household spending— A survey-based experiment
articles.title_cn: 房价预期与家庭支出——一项基于调查的实验
articles.abstract_en: I conduct a survey-based experiment to study the causal effect of house price expectations on individuals’ spending decisions. In the experiment, respondents are randomly divided into two groups to receive different professional forecasts of house prices. Exploiting this information treatment as an exogenous source of variation in house price expectations, I show that a one percentage point increase in expected nationwide house price growth over the next 12 months leads to about a 0.4 percentage point increase in intended total household spending growth over the same period. I show that this effect is likely driven by an expected increase in housing wealth and that individuals consider the increase in housing wealth as relaxing their borrowing constraints.
articles.abstract_cn: 我进行了一项基于调查的实验，以研究房价预期对个人支出决策的因果效应。在实验中，受访者被随机分为两组，接受不同的专业房价预测。利用这一信息处理作为房价预期变化的外生来源，我表明，未来12个月全国房价预期增长率每增加一个百分点，会导致同期家庭总支出预期增长率增加约0.4个百分点。我表明，这一效应很可能由预期住房财富增加所驱动，并且个人将住房财富的增加视为放松其借贷约束。

articles.title_en: Why do some nudges work and others not?
articles.title_cn: 为什么有些助推有效，而其他的无效？
articles.abstract_en: While nudges have recently gained popularity, many nudging interventions fail, and the effects of successful ones are often short-lived. We conjecture that the success of a nudge depends on how it interacts with the underlying economic incentives that determine the payoff-maximizing behavior of the decision-maker. For example, in the domain of tax compliance, a nudge is likely to be effective only if it is financially optimal for the taxpayer to pay the tax. To test our conjecture, we run a multi-period experiment in which we manipulate tax audit probability and nudge participants to report their income. In addition, we vary how often the nudge appears to test whether more frequent nudging increases long-run compliance. We observe that the first application of a nudge has a positive immediate effect on income reporting, irrespective of whether it is optimal to comply or not. However, subsequent nudges increase income reporting only if the nudge is aligned with the taxpayer’s incentives. More frequent nudging in the direction opposite to incentives yields no effects on long-run compliance. Policy implications are discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管助推近年来受到欢迎，但许多助推干预措施未能奏效，且成功干预的效果往往短暂。我们推测，助推的成功取决于其如何与决定决策者最大化收益行为的基础经济激励相互作用。例如，在税收遵从领域，只有当纳税人在财务上最优选择是缴纳税款时，助推才可能有效。为检验我们的推测，我们进行了一项多期实验，操纵税务审计概率并助推参与者报告其收入。此外，我们改变助推出现的频率，以测试更频繁的助推是否能提高长期遵从度。我们观察到，助推的首次应用对收入报告有即时的正向效果，无论遵从是否是最优选择。然而，后续的助推仅在助推与纳税人的激励一致时才会增加收入报告。与激励方向相反的更频繁助推对长期遵从度无效果。讨论了政策含义。

articles.title_en: Temporal framing of tax stimuli and household consumption
articles.title_cn: 税收刺激和家庭消费的时间框架
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a large-scale survey experiment with clients of a major German retail bank to examine whether the temporal framing of a tax stimulus as a permanent positive income shock affects consumption behavior. The income shock derives from the abolishment of the German solidarity surcharge on personal income taxes. Participants are randomly assigned to receive information about their additional disposable income in one of three formats: Euros per month (control), Euros per year (yearly treatment), or Euros per ten-year period (10-yearly treatment). We survey participants before the abolishment of the solidarity surcharge and find a statistically and economically significant impact of temporal framing on the intended use of the tax cut. The yearly and 10-yearly treatment groups’ average intended share of the tax cut for spending is 8.0 and 9.4 percentage points lower and for saving is 5.4 and 6.3 percentage points higher compared to the control group. A follow-up survey, six months after the tax rebate came into effect, reveals that participants largely adhered to their intentions, unless the increase in disposable income was diminished by other regulation changes. Those exposed to the yearly and 10-yearly treatments report having spent 7.0 and 8.4 percentage points less and report having saved 7.7 and 8.2 percentage points more relative to the control group. Treatment effects are particularly pronounced for larger tax cuts and among participants with low financial literacy and low cognitive reflection, who are more susceptible to the temporal framing of the rebate.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对德国一家大型零售银行的客户进行了一项大规模调查实验，以研究税收刺激作为永久性正收入冲击的时间框架是否会影响消费行为。收入冲击源于德国个人所得税团结附加费的取消。参与者被随机分配以三种格式之一接收有关其额外可支配收入的信息：每月欧元（对照）、每年欧元（每年治疗）或每十年欧元（10-每年治疗）。我们在废除团结附加费之前对参与者进行了调查，发现时间框架对减税的预期用途产生了统计上和经济上的重大影响。与对照组相比，每年和10每年的治疗组支出减税的平均预期份额降低了8.0和9.4个百分点，储蓄的平均预期份额提高了5.4和6.3个百分点。退税生效六个月后的一项后续调查显示，参与者基本上坚持了自己的意图，除非可支配收入的增长因其他监管变化而减少。那些接受每年和10每年治疗的人报告说，与对照组相比，花费减少了7.0和8.4个百分点，并报告节省了7.7和8.2个百分点。对于更大规模的减税，以及在金融知识和认知反思较低的参与者中，治疗效果尤其明显，他们更容易受到退税的时间框架的影响。

articles.title_en: Law, pride, and Contractual Relations
articles.title_cn: 法律、自尊与契约关系
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides theory and evidence on the role of informal institutions in contract enforcement, framed as the forfeiture of pride experienced by individualistic suppliers when they underperform or misappropriate others’ technology, and their interaction with law in shaping the behavior of firms. We demonstrate that achievement-oriented pride and self-esteem, more pronounced in individualistic societies, promote vertical integration in high-technology industries while encouraging outsourcing in low-technology sectors. Formal legal mechanisms mitigate the positive influence of pride on the longevity of business relationships, especially in high-technology sectors, where they act as a crucial substitute for deterring contract violations and infringement in less individualistic societies. For low-tech inputs, stricter law enforcement increases relationship duration up to a threshold level of individualism by compelling proud suppliers to invest despite receiving an insufficient payoff for their superior effort. This effect is more pronounced when their proportion is higher, suggesting a potential complementarity between law and pride in fostering longer-term relationships.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于非正式制度在契约执行中作用的理论与证据，将其框架化为个人主义供应商在表现不佳或挪用他人技术时所经历的自尊丧失，以及它们与法律在塑造企业行为中的相互作用。我们证明，在个人主义社会中更为显著的成就导向自尊和自尊心，促进了高科技产业的纵向整合，同时鼓励低技术部门的 outsourcing。正式法律机制削弱了自尊对商业关系持久性的积极影响，尤其是在高科技部门，在那里它们作为威慑契约违约和侵权的重要替代品，在个人主义较弱的社会中发挥作用。对于低技术投入，更严格的法律执行通过迫使自豪的供应商尽管为其卓越努力获得不足报酬仍进行投资，将关系持续时间增加到个人主义的一个阈值水平。当他们的比例较高时，这种效应更为显著，表明法律与自尊在促进长期关系方面可能存在互补性。

articles.title_en: Inference from field and laboratory experiments in economics: empirical evidence
articles.title_cn: 经济学中实地与实验室实验的推断：实证证据
articles.abstract_en: Experimental economics publications test and make claims that are based on inferences from the experimental datasets they are based on. We ask whether the environment that the authors make claims about matches the actual environment that exists in their data. We answer this question by employing a sample of 520 publications in 2018 and 2019 at leading general and field journals in Economics to test. This is important as out-of-domain inference may (or may not) lead to issues of over-generalization. We study inferences made in different types of field and laboratory experiments. The average match rates are 11 % for laboratory experiments and 39 % for field experiments on aggregate. Around four out of five field experiments fail to match in at least three out of the five domains, as with almost all laboratory experiments. We conclude that out-of-domain inference applies to the majority of field and laboratory experiments. Policy testing experiments have a higher match rate. Further, we find that publications by top 20 institutions authors or with experiments conducted in majority White countries are more likely to generalize out-of-domain; specifically, there appears to be an institutional bias tied to the country of the experiment.
articles.abstract_cn: 实验经济学出版物基于其实验数据集的推断进行测试并做出声明。我们询问作者所声称的环境是否与其数据中实际存在的环境相匹配。我们通过采用2018年和2019年在经济学顶级综合期刊和领域期刊上发表的520篇出版物样本来检验这一问题。这很重要，因为域外推断可能（或可能不）导致过度概括的问题。我们研究了不同类型实地和实验室实验中的推断。平均匹配率在实验室实验中为11%，在实地实验中总体为39%。大约五分之四的实地实验在五个领域中至少有三个领域未能匹配，几乎所有的实验室实验也是如此。我们得出结论，域外推断适用于大多数实地和实验室实验。政策测试实验的匹配率更高。此外，我们发现，来自前20名机构作者或实验在多数白人国家进行的出版物更可能进行域外概括；具体来说，似乎存在与实验所在国相关的制度偏见。

articles.title_en: Personal income tax reform and health insurance purchases: Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China
articles.title_cn: 个人所得税改革与健康保险购买：来自中国准自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of China’s 2018 personal income tax reform on residents’ health insurance purchasing behavior by analyzing nationally representative household survey data. Employing a quasi-natural experiment approach, the study finds that the reform significantly increased both the likelihood of Chinese households purchasing health insurance and their expenditure on health insurance premiums. This effect is primarily attributed to the reform’s enhancement of household disposable income. Heterogeneity analyses further demonstrate that the impact of the personal income tax reform on health insurance purchases is more pronounced in economically developed regions, among debt-free households, and in households with limited financial literacy. Notably, the reform has no significant effects on other types of insurance. This study offers a novel microeconomic perspective on how Chinese fiscal policy influences insurance purchasing behavior and provides valuable insights for the growth of the commercial health insurance market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过分析具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，考察了中国2018年个人所得税改革对居民健康保险购买行为的影响。采用准自然实验方法，研究发现改革显著提高了中国家庭购买健康保险的可能性及其健康保险保费支出。这一效应主要归因于改革对家庭可支配收入的提升。异质性分析进一步表明，个人所得税改革对健康保险购买的影响在经济发达地区、无债务家庭以及金融素养有限的家庭中更为显著。值得注意的是，改革对其他类型的保险没有显著影响。本研究为中国财政政策如何影响保险购买行为提供了新颖的微观经济视角，并为商业健康保险市场的增长提供了有价值的见解。
